8169044b5dfdfa8b016de9ace6703c3337be84e2.summary: Blackpoint Cyber reports that in November 2026 a legitimate business application used in the automotive industry was compromised through its software supply chain. Malicious JavaScript was inserted into the application's document rendering bundle, delivering a Node.js backdoor named IkonRAT that provides persistence and remote command execution. The report also describes recovered scripts for UAC bypass and exporting Windows registry hives, but says successful credential theft was not confirmed. The vendor removed the affected component.

81c9d894e544493159a57c858c0e9203fc405fab.summary: Check Point Research describes VoidLink, a modular Linux malware framework written in Zig and aimed at cloud and container environments. It has a web C2 dashboard, 37 plugins at the time of research, rootkit options, adaptive stealth, several C2 channels and anti-forensic modules. The developers are described as Chinese-affiliated, with exact affiliation unclear. The samples appear to be in-progress builds, and no real-world infections had been observed as of writing.
